title: Install Archipelago
subtitle: Install, update or uninstall the official Archipelago release.

missing.title: Archipelago is not installed
missing.body: The app downloads the official release from GitHub, checks its checksum and takes care of the rest.

update.title: An update is available
update.body: Archipelago {{version}} is out. Your settings and your list of worlds are backed up before the update.
update.handPicked: Archipelago {{version}} is out. The app does not update a folder picked by hand: update this copy yourself, or go back to automatic detection to let the app handle it.

current.title: Archipelago is up to date
current.body: You have the latest official release. Nothing to do: time to play.

unknown.title: Unknown Archipelago version
unknown.body: The installed version cannot be read or compared. Installing the latest release puts things back in order.
unknown.handPicked: The version of the folder picked by hand cannot be read. Check that it holds Archipelago, or go back to automatic detection.

appimage.title: Archipelago runs from an AppImage
appimage.body: The app never updates an AppImage. The managed install updates in one click and needs no FUSE.

unchecked.title: Archipelago {{version}} is installed
unchecked.error: Updates cannot be checked right now.

offer.uac: Windows will ask for administrator permission (UAC), just once. A small vc_redist window may also show up: that is normal.

options.title: Install options
options.desktopIconsHint: Shortcuts to the Launcher and to the Archipelago folder.
options.dirHintWin: By default, the installer uses C:\ProgramData\Archipelago, or keeps the current folder when updating.
options.dirHintLinux: By default, the app installs Archipelago in its own data folder.

location.title: Location
location.missingBody: Archipelago is already installed somewhere else (a portable copy, another folder)? Show the app its folder.
location.installedBody: Another copy of Archipelago? Choose its folder: the app will use it first.
location.customNote: While this folder is chosen, the app uses it first and leaves its updates to you.
location.foreignNote: The app did not install this copy: to remove it, delete it yourself.
location.notFoundBody: Choose the folder that holds ArchipelagoLauncher.
location.usedToast: The app now uses this folder

uninstall.title: Uninstall
uninstall.body: Removes Archipelago from this computer. Your YAML files, games and added worlds stay on disk, unless you ask to delete them.

dialog.title: Uninstall Archipelago?
dialog.body: The program will be removed. Your YAML files, games and added worlds stay on disk, unless you tick the box.
dialog.uac: Windows will ask for administrator permission (UAC).
dialog.purgeHint: Players (YAML), generated games, added worlds, logs and Archipelago settings.
dialog.purgeWarning: Your data will be deleted for good. Copy what you want to keep first.

hints.download: Downloading the official release from GitHub.
hints.verify: Checking the SHA-256 checksum of the file.
hints.backup: Backing up host.yaml, options.yaml and your list of worlds.
hints.quarantine: Setting aside broken APWorlds, which would block the installer.
hints.installWin: Accept the Windows permission request (UAC). A small vc_redist window may also show up: that is normal.
hints.installLinux: Copying the files into the folder the app manages.

done.title: Archipelago {{version}} is installed
done.body: All set: worlds, the Studio and your games now use this install.

removed.title: Archipelago is uninstalled
removed.kept: Your data stayed on disk: a new install will find it again.
removed.generic: The program was removed from this computer.

failed.install: The install did not go through
failed.uninstall: The uninstall did not go through

exitCodes.6: the installer was stopped by a debugger
exitCodes.8: the installer cannot proceed, and a restart is needed
